design.source_sampling: uniform without replacement from 1m BASE points
design.uniform_target: one uniformly sampled distinct BASE ID per source
design.probe_near_target: closest by exact Float64 L2 among 256 uniformly sampled distinct BASE IDs per source; NOT true kNN
design.float_processing: Float32 base promoted to Float64; classify borderline |d2-threshold2| <= 1e-12*max(1,threshold2) UNKNOWN
design.graph_subset_check: all outgoing neighbors in sampled rows must be in post-reservoir pool row
design.leakage_control: BASE ids only; no heldout query ground truth
design.inference_limit: sample descriptive only, no claims about all n*(n-1) ordered pairs, query Recall or global alpha guarantee
